title: Bay State Gas Company files for review and approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Special Firm Transportation Agreement with MASSPOWER.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: Letter on behalf of Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas of Massachusetts informing the Department of the Company's intent to terminate the Special Firm Transportation Agreement entered into as of August 29, 2005. DPU 05-GC-22

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Judith F. Judson and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 05-GC-22)
